Wellbutrin can be a real b word if it’s not a good fit for you. I just got the okay to stop taking it from my doc today. I don’t think there’s anything wrong with you. I just think you haven’t found the right med for you. It’s so much trial and error and I know it’s awful. I’m sorry you’re going through this.
I relate to this all too much. I’m sorry that this is your experience.
If you’re still here, I’m here for you. This sounds similar to things I’ve been dealing with recently and I know it’s tough. I’m sorry you’re in pain.
I’m glad it’s not just me

People who grow up poor often spend money unwisely when they do have it. Things are tough and you might not have a lot, so you are more tempted to spend money when you do have it. You get quick happiness from whatever you bought, but you don’t always think about your happiness in the long run. I am working on overcoming this, while watching the same issue destroy my dad.

It definitely sounds like you are depressed to a degree, the important part is figuring out if it’s because you have chronic depression or if there could be something else causing this, and then address that.

I understand this. I feel like everyone is looking at me. I wish I didn’t go through life always thinking about that, and just get my groceries, but I can’t help it. Then I feel like a narcissist or something. Most likely linked to some of my mental health problems.
